purpose: Measure remote Codex CPU feasibility and conditional seed variance before a scientific HPO/NAS campaign.
data_audit_disclosure: Read-only audit may verify complete authorised 2023-2024 derivatives; training admission is phase-specific. No 2025-2026 market archive or labels are authorised by this pilot.
target: Population standard deviation ddof0 of seven daily log returns, unannualized; not intraday realised volatility.

resources.models: All 14 neural reference architectures plus largest TimesNet w256-256-256:b111; fixed published bodies remain unchanged.
resources.fixed_recipe: Protocol27 noise_and_resource_pilot_fixed_nonarchitecture; no HPO winner or selection on pilot model scores.
resources.amendment: Operational reconnaissance with a smaller external process cap. Does not replace the registered full-budget noise/resource pilot or the 7200s full scientific stage cap.
resources.failures: Record terminal error/censoring, partial cost and no replacement seed/trial; unknown steps remain null.

preselection_variance.recipe: Frozen protocol27 nonarchitecture defaults and reference architectures; not recipes selected by October HPO/NAS.
preselection_variance.amendment: A preselection reference pilot permitted by guide9.2. The original postselection power-pilot gate remains pending; report conditional projections, not final achieved power.
preselection_variance.epoch_selection_rule: Five fresh selection fits per model. Ceil median of strict best supervised epochs across all five seeds; no architecture/HPO selection.
preselection_variance.refit_rule: New model/optimizer/train-only scaler for each seed at fixed epochs; predict-before-observe daily; model fingerprint invariant.
preselection_variance.paired_metric: Per-seed RMSE difference, original sigma units; common seeds and dates.

multiplicity.primary_family: All unordered pairs among 18 systems on primary RMSE
multiplicity.adjustment: Bonferroni sizing bound, distinct from final rank/MCS inference

simulation.sensitivity_scope: Seed resampling and temporal-block sensitivity conditional on 53 development dates and reference recipes; not actual power of final 608-date inference.

preselection_variance.R_final_gate: Do not set protocol final_seed_count from this reference-only pilot; report conditional R recommendation/MDE and retain original postselection gate.
preselection_variance.wall_estimate_scope: Profile and report measured pilot wall time plus cap-based campaign bounds. Do not extrapolate reference timing as validated total scientific campaign hours.

k_gate.original_full_noise_pilot: 12 fixed architectures x5 seeds x6 families, full budget, absent unless explicitly executed.
k_gate.when_rank_stability_unavailable: Conservative operational k40; disclose rule not fully evaluated and no guarantee of global optimum.

publication: Commit this registration to GitHub before market fitting, then publish code, receipts, decisions and limitations in the JBook.
excluded: Full18-trial HPO,1000-design NAS,final refits,608-date evaluation,negative controls,robustness,calibration,interpretability and independent reproduction.
